lcc_original: 他們和一切走獸、各從其類、一切牲口、各從其類，爬在地上的一切爬行動物、各從其類，一切禽鳥、各從其類：各種羽族各樣鳥兒：
notes: UNV 百獸<WH02416> → LCC 走獸<WH02416>: different compound but same Hebrew חַיָּה (living creature/beast)
UNV 牲畜<WH0929> → LCC 牲口<WH0929>: synonymous Chinese terms for livestock (H929 בְּהֵמָה)
UNV 昆蟲<WH07431> → LCC 爬行動物<WH07431>: LCC uses more accurate rendering for רֶמֶשׂ (creeping things)
UNV 禽<WH05775>...鳥<WH06833> → LCC 禽鳥<WH05775><WH06833>: LCC merges into compound; the implicit {<WAH03605>} between UNV 禽 and 鳥 is absorbed into the leading 一切<WAH03605>
UNV {<WAH03605>}{<WH03671>} (both implicit) → LCC 各種羽族: both became explicit in LCC so braces dropped; 各種<WAH03605> and 羽族<WH03671>
LCC 各樣鳥兒 is elaborative Chinese gloss with no direct Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated
